annotation.title_clean: 市场监管总局等七部门关于印发《以标准提升牵引设备更新和消费品以旧换新行动方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice by SAMR and Six Other Departments on Issuing the Action Plan for Standards Improvement to Drive Equipment Renewal and Consumer Goods Trade-in
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家市场监督管理总局 (SAMR) et al. (NDRC, MIIT, MEE, MOHURD, MOFCOM, MEM)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese seven-ministry action plan, approved by the State Council, to accelerate revision of 294 national standards by 2025 supporting equipment renewal and consumer trade-ins. Covers energy efficiency, emissions, safety, recycling. Embodied-AI content is minor: autonomous driving and lidar standards, drone airworthiness standards, and a regulatory sandbox for intelligent driving.
key_provisions_or_claims: Complete 294 key national standards by 2025 (129 in 2024, 165 in 2025)
Strengthen standards for autonomous driving, lidar and intelligent connected vehicle cybersecurity and data security
Develop standards for drone flight testing, logistics drones and airworthiness to support the low-altitude economy
Explore a product-safety 'sandbox regulation' system for intelligent driving
Raise consistency of consumer-goods standards with international standards to over 96%
